_comment: Companion-app OTA manifest. The installed app fetches this from raw.githubusercontent.com (main) on demand, compares versionCode, and offers to download+install the apk when this is newer. Bump BOTH fields on every app release and upload the matching apk as the release asset named below. The app track is versioned INDEPENDENTLY of the Nexus Q image releases.
notes: Lights: switch the LED ring off, put it on a schedule, let it dim with the daylight, pick theme and visualisation. One volume shared with Spotify, AirPlay, the dome and Home Assistant. The app tells you when your Q has a new release and shows what it brought. Developer: device diagnostics and idle depth. Signed with a new release key (the update installs in place). Made for Nexus Q v2.0.0.
